capabilities: Generate daily, weekly, monthly and yearly time reports as code blocks in notes
Show an interactive dashboard with heatmaps, bar charts and donut charts
Group tracked entries into categories based on file tags
Compare tracked time against per-category targets and carry deviation across months
Mark days off, vacation, sick days and public holidays in a year planner
extras: After each major version update the plugin fetches that release's notes once from the GitHub API (api.github.com); no other network use. It is not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This is a statistics companion plugin for the Super Simple Time Tracker by Ellpeck.
problem: Super Simple Time Tracker records time per note but offers no vault-wide summaries, so users needed custom scripts to see totals, deviations and trends.

relations.evidence: This is a statistics companion plugin for the Super Simple Time Tracker by Ellpeck.
Dataview: Required for the plugin to scan and aggregate data.

summary: Statistics companion for the Super Simple Time Tracker that aggregates vault-wide tracked time into daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports with targets and charts.
